method: One pass over every unresolved edge carrying text, keying each with the same pure normalisation the resolver uses, counting how many edges each alias row would carry. No resolver output is read.
finding: 4,394 derived alias rows carry 1,548,529 of the 2,913,749 pinnable edges. One alias row carries 66,171 of them. The alias path cannot produce AMBIGUOUS — judgment_citation_aliases_key is a UNIQUE index — so a wrong alias is a confident wrong pin that no resolver gate can fire on, multiplied by its edge count.
